🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; confirmed by cyclical leadership in Energy (VLO (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +25.95%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +12.77% | 1M: +25.42%) ABOVE TREND) and concurrent 1W strength across Technology names (INTU (1W: +15.45% | 1M: -9.64%) RECOVERY) and Communication (NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND). Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 span 3 sectors).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: VLO (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +25.95%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +12.77% | 1M: +25.42%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +8.43% | 1M: +16.76%) ABOVE TREND. Communication strength driven by NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND and broader 1W gains. Technology showing 1W momentum pockets: INTU (1W: +15.45% | 1M: -9.64%) RECOVERY, PLTR (1W: +14.16% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Staples weak: EL (1W: -11.87% | 1M: -16.20%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -3.07%) BELOW TREND. Materials and Financials underperforming overall with pockets of strain; Materials example DOW is an exception (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +13.31%) ABOVE TREND. Financials headline names are generally flat-to-negative (JPM (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -2.84%) BELOW TREND).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +15.45% | 1M: -9.64%) RECOVERY, PLTR (1W: +14.16% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +25.95%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +12.77% | 1M: +25.42%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 span Communication, Technology and Energy).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: EL (1W: -11.87% | 1M: -16.20%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -11.23% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -10.51% | 1M: -6.00%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -9.42% | 1M: +9.08%) CORRECTION, ASML (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -2.79%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select high-multiple and discretionary names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Biggest 1W movers: NFLX (1W: +19.30%), INTU (1W: +15.45%), PLTR (1W: +14.16%), VLO (1W: +13.00%), MPC (1W: +12.77%). Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE across large caps (MSFT, META, AMZN, V, MA showing 1W vs 1M mismatches) — tactical caution and "watch for trend break" despite RISK-ON backdrop.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed/rotational: INTU (1W: +15.45% | 1M: -9.64%) RECOVERY and PLTR (1W: +14.16% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND offset by heavy semicap weakness — LRCX (1W: -10.51% | 1M: -6.00%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -1.38%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: +0.96% but 1M weakness persists (Technology mixed momentum).

8. Financials Outlook?
Under pressure and mixed: JPM (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -2.84%) BELOW TREND while payment names show short-term RECOVERY (V (1W: +2.39% | 1M: -3.81%) RECOVERY; MA (1W: +2.66% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY). Sector 1W: -1.99% — Financials not leading in this risk-on leg.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Cautious constructive: UNH (1W: +2.73% | 1M: +2.23%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, but LLY (1W: -2.46% | 1M: -3.72%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: +0.01% — defensive names showing selective strength.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals—select Energy plays (VLO, MPC, PSX) and Communication strength (NFLX) while reducing exposure to the weakest discretionary and certain large-cap Tech laggards (AAPL (1W: -4.27% | 1M: -2.68%) BELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -1.38%) BELOW TREND). Given the MAJOR DIVERGENCE in large caps, keep positions tactical and monitor earnings/news flow for confirmation.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND; VLO (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +25.95%) ABOVE TREND; PLTR (1W: +14.16% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: EL (1W: -11.87% | 1M: -16.20%) BELOW TREND; LRCX (1W: -10.51% | 1M: -6.00%) BELOW TREND; AAPL (1W: -4.27% | 1M: -2.68%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.55% | 1M: +15.43%) and Communication (1W: +3.40% | 1M: +7.11%) for continuation. BEARISH: Consumer Staples (1W: -2.99% | 1M: +1.95%), Financials (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -5.49%) and Materials (1W: -2.12% | 1M: +3.52%) for downside risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA for failure to reclaim the recent 1M range (continued BELOW TREND would increase tech downside risk); AAPL breach of recent 1W lows would confirm continued weakness (AAPL (1W: -4.27% | 1M: -2.68%) BELOW TREND). Monitor VLO/MPC for follow-through above this week’s breakout pace as confirmation of cyclical leadership.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AAPL (+55): Headline: aggressive AI push; Price diverging — AAPL (1W: -4.27% | 1M: -2.68%) BELOW TREND, sentiment not yet confirmed by price. ABT (+80): positive FDA framing (price not in provided snapshot for dual timeframe confirmation). Note: several bullish headlines (EA, NVS, CSCO) exist but are outside the provided dual-time snapshot.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PLTR (-50): Headline: price-target cut; PLTR (1W: +14.16% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND — clear divergence (negative news but strong price). AMAT (-50): Headline: sector downgrades; AMAT (1W: -9.42% | 1M: +9.08%) CORRECTION — sentiment confirmed by price pullback. RCL (-50): RCL (1W: -8.24% | 1M: -14.02%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. UNH (-45): UNH (1W: +2.73% | 1M: +2.23%) ABOVE TREND — negative news but price holding, watch for follow-through.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style. NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +25.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.16% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among large-cap Tech and conflicting sentiment (PLTR, AAPL) — watch for confirmation before expanding exposure.
